findings.message: The sample entry of track 1 states a sample rate of 44100 Hz, but its Dolby TrueHD stream has 48000 Hz (Encspect compares them because ffmpeg's muxer writes the stream's own; the rule of Dolby's binding was not read).
The sample entry of track 1 states 2 channels, but its Dolby TrueHD stream has 1 (Encspect compares them because ffmpeg's muxer writes the stream's own; the rule of Dolby's binding was not read).
The dmlp box states a peak data rate of 3327 sixteenths of a bit per sample period where the major sync has 3199; the box repeats the first major sync's fields.
